All the covers pertaining to my own AI GENERATED comics.

Each comic is never a repeat, always a unique one-shot story, there is everything for anybody.

These comics focus mostly on lesser known characters from either well known IPs or lesser known IPs deserving notoriety - example: Kisara and Arshtat from Suikoden 5, Hel from Valkyrie Profile.

From July 2026, When this gallery is bumped up, it means a new comic has been up at the link here:

https://storinex.com/creator/ddark92
